intro: Trying to find scholarships for Kenyan students in the USA usually means sorting through mixed eligibility rules, study levels, and application asks. This filtered slice brings those listings into one place so you can compare options that may fit international applicants across education, STEM, community, medicine, arts, and other subjects. The rows below are not all the same: award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and some applications appear lighter while others may ask for essays or more supporting details. If you want to apply in the USA with a clearer shortlist, use this view to scan titles, check requirement lines, and focus first on the programs that match your level, field, and residency or citizenship wording.
